testcase.name: Scenario: move-22 Auto Fade reduces toolbar and hover restores it: tmp/obk-auto-fade-source/features/sketch/move/scenario.feature:197:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: move-22 Auto Fade reduces toolbar and hover restores it ✔ Given an editable sketch with eligible geometry ✔ Given the mini-toolbar is visible with Pin checked and Auto Fade unchecked ✔ When Auto Fade is enabled and the pointer remains away ✔ Then the mode selector and lower toolbar row disappear while numeric fields remain ✔ When the pointer hovers over the Y input ✔ Then the full toolbar reappears ✔ And reopened Settings shows Auto Fade checked ✔ When Auto Fade is disabled and Settings is reopened ✔ Then Auto Fade is unchecked
